name: Weave Fabric
description:
Weave Fabric is a personal memory layer for AI. Connect it to Claude and your assistant finally knows the specifics of your life: your people, preferences, routines, purchases, calendar, and history.
You build your memory in the Weave Fabric iOS app. Capture quick notes, fill out short questionnaires about parts of your life (food, work, health, travel, and more), or connect accounts like Gmail, Google Calendar, Apple Health, YouTube, Eventbrite, Receipts, Instagram, LinkedIn, Slack, Discord, and HubSpot to generate memories automatically from data you already have. Once connected, Claude can read, create, and update memories on your behalf.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Weave Fabric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Weave Fabric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.weave.cloud/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Weave Fabric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weave Fabric provides these MCP tools: weave_create_memory, weave_edit_memory, weave_forget_memory, weave_get_by_tag, weave_list_memories, weave_list_tags, weave_rename_tag, and weave_search_memories.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Weave Fabric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Weave Fabric in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Weave Fabric MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weave Fabric requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Weave Fabric is developed by Weave. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
